sub_palette: germanic (gothic) backbone + near_eastern (old_persian / axsatran) overlay (cross-family blend, Germanic-leaning)

blend.backbone: germanic (continental / Gothic register: thiudans/reiks, dithematic -s/-az names, retained th/w, ai/au diphthongs, heavy root-initial stress - the Iranian-Germanic Alan horse-aristocracy)
blend.overlay: near_eastern (old_persian / axsatran: the -pura cities and dida-citadels, the satrapal Xshacapavan/Marzapana office-register, the paridaida garden-courts, the poet-king populace, vowel-rich Indo-Iranian phonology, the genitive '-ahya')
blend.lean: Germanic-heavy - a Gothic-Alan horse-aristocracy (Iranian-Germanic steppe-lords, a thiudans-house of riders) enthroned over the refined Persian heartland: the war-band of the saddle rules, the courtly poet-king cities and their satrapal scribes endure and serve beneath. Steppe-lords over the land of poet-kings.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_01 Thiodmark (Germanic) x BASE_04 (Persian; the axsatran heartland). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Germanic base = Clanhold, Persian base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Aryamark is Civilized (feudal). Concept: the Alans were an Iranian people allied and fused with the Goths - an Iranian-Germanic synthesis; here that Gothic-Alan horse-aristocracy has ridden down and enthroned itself over the refined Persian heartland (the land of poet-kings). Backbone = Germanic (Gothic/continental: the ruling war-aristocracy of riders, the thiudans/reiks register, dithematic names, the PRIMARY deity reflexes); overlay/substrate = Persian (the existing -pura cities, the dida-citadels, the satrapal Xshacapavan office, the courtly-poetic populace, the SECONDARY deity-morphs). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Gothic and Old-Persian registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Gothic reflexes primary, Old-Persian/axsatran variants secondary), never real Germanic/Iranian/Zoroastrian gods (no Wodan/Odin, no Ahura Mazda/Mithra). PROVISIONAL: alignment (Lawful/Neutral) is a per-hybrid design choice pending the alignment pass - the Germanic war-oath order meets the Persian Arta (Truth/Right-order) tradition; both read Lawful-friendly, the steppe-riders' ancestor-cult reads Neutral. Register choice: Germanic-base hybrids default to the GOTHIC/continental reflexes (rationale here is doubled - the Alans WERE the Iranian-Germanic Goths-allied riders); Brythald (HYB_01) is the Anglo-Saxon special case - flag for Jedidiah if a uniform Germanic register is wanted instead. [UPDATE 2026-06-27: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per-hybrid alignment restriction removed). Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are now English (or an approved foreign term); conlang titles moved to ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. Deities unchanged: canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.]

phonology.palette: Germanic (Gothic) backbone - heavy root-initial stress, sharp stops p/t/k b/d/g, retained th/w, ai/au diphthongs, dithematic compounding - meeting an Old Persian overlay: vowels a i u with long a/i/u, the spirants th/x(kh)/f, sibilants s/sh/z and c(ts), the clusters xsh-/sp-/st-/fr-/thr-, the characteristic endings -a/-ah/-iya/-ana/-aspa(horse)/-arta(truth)/-farnah(glory). Per the CSV: flowing Persian vowels introduced to the harsh Germanic consonants, with a poetic court-stress; grammar shifts toward SOV with retained case-inflections (the Persian/Indo-Iranian substrate) carried on Germanic strong/weak stems. Theophoric on the Gothic reflexes (Thulrs-, Erlands-) with Old-Persian construct variants (Turvasa-, Urlaspa-, Arta-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC meeting CV(C); Germanic clusters (st, sk, br, kn) alongside Old Persian xsh-/sp-/fr-/thr-; heavy Germanic initial stress softened by a Persian heavy-syllable and poetic court-stress; vowel length distinctive (the Persian flowing vowels); dithematic Gothic names over Dida-/-pura/-stana toponyms; the genitive-of-relation '-ahya'.

sound_changes: Old Persian flowing/long vowels clip to Gothic short stressed nuclei: long a/i/u shorten, hiatus collapses (draya>dray, raha>rah), Persian vowel-length is lost
Persian word-final inflectional endings drop: final -a/-ah/-iya/-ana/-aka>0 so roots become consonant-final (rautah>rauth, vana>wan, namaka>namak, pura>pur in compounds)
Persian phonemes fold into the Gothic inventory: v>w, c(ts)>k, x(kh)>h, voiced spirant-th kept as th; Persian s/sh/z retained as the audible substrate sibilants
Gothic root-initial stress on every word; Gothic clusters (st, sk, br, kn) permitted; the exotic Persian onsets xsh-/fr-/thr- simplify (xsh->ks/h) except where a portmanteau preserves them
retain Gothic th, w, ai, au and the Gothic strong-ending -s on bare adjective/kin stems; the Persian moral abstracts arta/drauga survive un-clipped as loan-vocabulary
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain/material/staple words from Old Persian roots (the poet-king populace works the heartland: rautah>rauth, kaufa>kauf, vana>wan, yava>yaw, namaka>namak); kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Gothic roots (the saddle-aristocracy's register: mikils>mikil, swarts>swart, eisarn, marh); every root then filtered to one Gothic-shaped phonology; the Persian virtue-pair arta/drauga carried over whole as the court's moral vocabulary

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Old-Persian land/terrain/material roots clipped to Gothic stress and ending-stripped + Gothic rule/kin/war-roots, all run through one Germanic-shaped sound-law; portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline; the Persian virtue-pair arta/drauga survives as loaned court-vocabulary.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Gothic-Alan ruling house keeps a dithematic lineage-name and -ingos; the Persian populace keep the filiation 'X-ahya puthra' (son of X) or compact 'X-puthra' and a house (vith-X) or office; the throne fuses both - a thiudans who also bears a vith- house-name and a satrapal seat.
morphology.compounding_rule: Germanic dithematic ([quality](stem) + element: Eisarna-burgs, iron-fort) layered over Old Persian relation-compounds and construct via '-ahya' (Arta-xshaca, truth-realm; Dida-[name], fort of; [name]-pura, city of): the capital Gutaxsatra (the Goth-realm), Dida-Theuda (citadel of the Theuda-house).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Gothic-Alan horse-aristocracy over the Persian satrapal heartland: the thiudans and his reiks-kin in the saddle at the crown, the kindins-governors and the Persian Xshacapavan-satraps over the -pura cities, the gardingus-retainers and asabara-riders sworn to the war-host; the magi tend the fire and the scribal court endures beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Gothic ladder, ascending, with the Old-Persian satrapal substrate co-titles beneath. Gardingus (king's-man) barony; Marka-frauja (march-lord) march; Kindins (provincial governor) county; Drauhtins (war-lord; *druhtinaz) duchy ruling over a Xshacapavanam (the Persian SATRAPY he holds as a war-fief); Reiks (prince-ruler) principality; Thiudans (king) kingdom over a Thiudangardi (Gothic 'kingdom'); Thiudans-Xshayathiya (the king-of-kings; Gmc thiudans + OP Xshayathiya) empire over the Vispa-Thiudi (the 'all-the-peoples'). The subject cities keep their Persian Xshacapavan (satrap) and Framatar (appointed governor) and Marzapana (march-warden) beneath the Gothic crown. The gudja (priest) and the Persian magu stand outside the ladder. Rank titles fuse the real Gothic and Old-Persian registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Thiudans-barn (the king's child; the heir) / Mathishta (the greatest; crown prince)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Gothic-Alan ruling stock carry a dithematic name + -ingos lineage; the Persian populace carry a theophoric or Arta-/Vahu- virtue given name + filiation (X-puthra); order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Gothic-Alan war-aristocracy keep Gothic dithematic names (Theud-, Erman-, -reiks, -mers); the Persian court-and-city folk keep theophoric and virtue names (Turvasa-data, Arta-X, Vahu-X) on the morphed canon-stems with the -puthra filiation.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Germanic devotional on the Gothic god-reflexes (Thulrs-mers, Erlands-); Persian devotional constructs on the shifted stems and on Arta- (Truth): Turvasa-data (Turvasa-given), Baga-Urlaspa, Artafarnah, Vahu-Arzanta.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Gothic Germanic reflexes PRIMARY (family_germanic theonym_ancestors, the gothic column: Thulrs, Erlands, Gauands, Numins, Riala, Aiterns), Old-Persian/axsatran variants SECONDARY (the axsatran shifted morphs: Turvasa, Urlaspa, Gayanta, Naumana, Riyata, Asturna), never real Germanic/Iranian/Zoroastrian gods. The cardinal Persian virtue ARTA (Truth/Right-order) and its opposite DRAUGA (the Lie) carry over as the court's moral vocabulary, fused with the Germanic war-oath. Alignment PROVISIONAL (Lawful/Neutral): the Germanic war-oath order meets the Persian Arta tradition; both read Lawful-friendly, the steppe-riders' ancestor-cult reads Neutral. The realm is broadly TOLERANT in the Persian manner - the thiudans shelters the subject cults beneath the crown.
religion.the_one: Aiterns (Gothic; Persian Asturna) - the distant Ancient One and Wise Lord Most High, upholder of Arta, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Thulrs (Pers. Turvasa) - the sun, justice, and the lamp of right-order
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Erlands (Pers. Urlaspa) - iron, oath, war, and the cavalier
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gauands (Pers. Gayanta) - the enduring earth and mountain
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numins (Pers. Naumana) - sky, lightning, and the good-mind wisdom
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Riala (Pers. Riyata) - the mother, mercy, the Lady of Waters

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiterns, Thulrs the just, Erlands of the sworn war, Riala the merciful - upholding Arta (right-order) and naming the Chaotic powers the hosts of Drauga the Lie, warded as skohsla (Gothic demons); the war-oath and the king's-word-as-bond bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead (the Anses of the ruling Alan house) honored as fravashi (fore-spirits), and the city-spirits of the -pura; the great powers invoked at the alhs-grove and the fire-altar situationally
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, and names the Lawful powers - and Aiterns - as the tyrant-gods to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as skohsla (Gothic demons) or the hosts of Drauga (the Persian Lie), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Marahs the War-Brand (Pers. Marakhsha the Burner-of-Cities); Vacidus -> Wakiths the Unmaker (Pers. Vakida the Devouring-Void); Lusanto -> Lusanths the Hoard-Worm (Pers. Lusanta the Coin-Serpent).

clergy_ladder.5: Weiha-gudja (consecrated priest) / Magupati (chief magus of a fire-temple)
clergy_ladder.9: Sinista-gudja (eldest priest) / Magupatan Magupat (chief of chief magi)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Alhs (Germanic grove-temple) or the Atashana (Persian fire-temple) of [power]: 'the Alhs of Thulrs', 'the Atashana of Turvasa'; the magi keep the ever-burning fire (Atar) on the altar.
religion.saints_pattern: the Anses (the deified war-dead of the ruling Alan house) and the honest dead and just kings of the Persian cities, kept as fravashi (fore-spirits) and honored at the howe, the standing stone, and the fire-altar; 'the Arta-true [name]' (the righteous [name]).

holy_symbol_motifs.Thulrs: a rayed sun-disc over a crossed sword and the upright Arta-measure
holy_symbol_motifs.Erlands: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring
holy_symbol_motifs.Gauands: the enduring mountain beneath the winged ring-disc (the farnah-glory)

banks_patterns.ships: the few river-barges and royal-road craft of a horse-and-land power: 'Pride of the Rautah', 'Bearer of the Baji', 'Boat of Turvasa'
banks_patterns.military_units: the Thiudans' hari (war-host) and the Persian-style cavalry guard: 'the Hari of Aryamark', 'the Spada of Urlaspa', 'the Iron Asabara (the Ten-Thousand riders)'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Golden Farnah', 'The Boar and Cup', 'The Cup of Truth (Arta-jam)'
